entities.name: Silvino García Martínez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Silvino García Martínez is a Cuban chess player. He was awarded the title of Grandmaster (GM) by FIDE in 1975. García Martínez is a four-time Cuban champion. He was also Pan American champion in 1968 and won an individual bronze medal at the Chess Olympiad in 1978.

entities.summary: Silvino García Martínez is a Cuban chess player. He was awarded the title of Grandmaster (GM) by FIDE in 1975. García Martínez is a four-time Cuban champion. He was also Pan American champion in 1968 and won an individual bronze medal at the Chess Olympiad in 1978.
